composition.serve_who: This sheet (09 of 25, "16 DI MODULE (POS.01) 750-1405 DI-01", section MAST) is a WAGO 750 I/O rack drawing showing digital input channels for pushbutton/switch commands. Each channel's signal name identifies the equipment it serves: capstan (CW/CCW), windlass (slow/fast up/down), hydraulic ON/OFF (system-wide, no dedicated node), forestay RTA (in/out), and four mast winches (aft port, fwd port, aft stbd, fwd stbd) each with 1°/3° and 2° speed pushbuttons. The rack/coupler itself (750-8213 CPU, POS 01, +24Vdc field supply rails) is infrastructure for the MAST PLC rack, not equipment.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Signal names 'capstan CW_pusw_AL' and 'capstan CCW_pusw_AL' directly name the capstan; mapped via engineer glossary to 220-capstan-winch.

functions.label: Capstan rotation direction pushbutton command
functions.what_it_does: Two pushbutton inputs command the capstan drum to rotate clockwise or counter-clockwise; each channel is a discrete alarm-type (_AL) pushbutton input read by the PLC to drive the capstan direction output.

flow_scenarios.path: No pushbutton pressed -> both CH01 and CH02 read LOW (open) -> no capstan rotation command issued.
Field pushbutton (capstan CW_pusw_AL) -> DI-01 CH01 (module 750-1405, rack position 01) -> PLC reads channel HIGH relative to module COMMON -> PLC energises capstan CW rotation output.
Field pushbutton (capstan CCW_pusw_AL) -> DI-01 CH02 -> PLC reads channel HIGH relative to module COMMON -> PLC energises capstan CCW rotation output.

key_components: module COMMON (rail reference, not individually numbered on this sheet)

functions.label: Windlass speed/direction pushbutton commands
functions.what_it_does: Four pushbutton inputs command the windlass to raise or lower the anchor at slow or fast speed.

flow_scenarios.path: No pushbutton pressed -> CH03-CH06 all LOW -> no windlass motion command.
Field pushbutton (windlass SLOW UP_pusw_AL) -> DI-01 CH03 -> PLC reads HIGH relative to module COMMON -> PLC energises windlass UP at slow speed.
Field pushbutton (windlass SLOW DOWN_pusw_AL) -> DI-01 CH04 -> PLC reads HIGH relative to module COMMON -> PLC energises windlass DOWN at slow speed.
Field pushbutton (windlass FAST UP_pusw_AL) -> DI-01 CH05 -> PLC reads HIGH relative to module COMMON -> PLC energises windlass UP at fast speed.
Field pushbutton (windlass FAST DOWN_pusw_AL) -> DI-01 CH06 -> PLC reads HIGH relative to module COMMON -> PLC energises windlass DOWN at fast speed.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Hydraulic system ON/OFF (MAST hydraulic power pack enable)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Signal 'hydraulic ON/OFF_pb_AL' (CH07) is a general system enable command, not tied to one named winch/furler; placed on the MYT hydraulics power/control node as the closest fitting node for a hydraulic-system-wide enable pushbutton on the MAST PLC.

functions.label: Hydraulic system enable/disable pushbutton command
functions.what_it_does: Pushbutton input toggles the mast hydraulic power system ON or OFF, enabling/disabling hydraulic power to all mast deck equipment served by this PLC.

flow_scenarios.path: No pushbutton pressed -> CH07 LOW -> hydraulic system state unchanged.
Field pushbutton (hydraulic ON/OFF_pb_AL) -> DI-01 CH07 -> PLC reads HIGH relative to module COMMON -> PLC toggles hydraulic power pack enable/disable output.

infrastructure.system_name: MAST PLC I/O Rack (WAGO 750 series, position 01)
facts: 16 DI MODULE, type 750-1405, mounted at rack POS.01, CPU 750-8213 (fieldbus coupler/controller for the rack).
Module designation DI-01 with 16 channels (CH01-CH16), wired in pairs left/right per row.

+24Vdc (field) supply rail runs vertically on both left and right sides of the sheet feeding all field pushbuttons/switches; cross-reference tags 9.7E/6.4C (left rail) and 10.2E/9.2B (right rail) indicate continuation to/from other sheets.
Sheet is part of file SWS_108-1_MAST PLC.dwg, sheet 09 of 25, section MAST, project SWS 108-1, rev 3.

uncertainties: Channel COMMON terminal for module 750-1405 DI-01 is not individually labeled on this sheet (WAGO 750-1405 modules typically share a common per channel pair or per module depending on wiring convention) — exact COMMON terminal number should be confirmed from module datasheet/wiring table if precise multimeter probe placement is needed.

No dedicated 2nd-speed pushbutton channel appears for 'mast winch fwd stbd' on this module (only CH16 '1° e 3°' is present); unclear whether the 2nd-speed command for this winch is wired on a different DI module/sheet or omitted — flagged rather than assumed.

'hydraulic ON/OFF_pb_AL' has no specific hydraulic power pack node in the register for this exact function; attached to 570-myt-systems-hydraulics as the closest general hydraulics node — may need a more specific 'power pack enable' node if one exists elsewhere.
